2024_general.fact: 'Summary Results for General Election November 5, 2024' (2024/summary Results for General Election.pdf): 'Summary Results Report Totals for Website TX Fisher 241105 General ... Election Day Precincts Reporting 4 of 4', county TOTAL column only (Trump 1,487), printed 'Election Summary - 11/05/2024 8:31 PM'; Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 03:27:56 GMT (9:27 PM CST election night). 'OFFICIAL RESULTS' (2024/Official results.pdf, Last-Modified 19 Nov 2024) is also county totals by vote type (printed 11/18/2024), so precinct numbers are never published online. Seed domain co.fisher.tx.us is robots-disallowed/unreachable; used fishercounty.org.

2026_primary.fact: 'Unofficial Results' (2026/March 3/unofficial results.pdf): county-totals 'Summary Results Report Unofficial Results TX Fisher 260303 Primary', printed 'Election Summary - 03/06/2026 10:08 AM', Last-Modified Fri, 06 Mar 2026 16:08:40 GMT, after election night. Other files are reconciliation, hand-count audit, canvass notice, official results. No election-night file survives; no wayback folder (check 3 unavailable).

2026_runoff.fact: 'Unofficial Results' (May 26 Runoff/unofficial results .pdf): scanned 'Summary Results Report TX Fisher 260526 Primary Runoff ... UNOFFICIAL RESULTS', county totals, printed 'Election Summary - 06/05/2026 10:31 AM', Last-Modified Fri, 05 Jun 2026 15:44:12 GMT. Other runoff files are reconciliations, audits, official results. No election-night results file survives.

rationale: Only 2024 is determined: a county-totals 'Totals for Website' report printed 8:31 PM and uploaded 9:27 PM on election night, with no precinct numbers then or later (LATER). The 2026 elections have only post-election-night files. One determined election, so COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS, low.
